item.title: Switch 2 Mario Kart and 7 more new deals
item.description:
8 new deals this morning, each one checked by hand.

Nintendo Switch 2 + Mario Kart World Bundle at Best Buy
The Switch 2 bundle with Mario Kart World is a Best Buy Doorbuster at $499.99, the same price as the console on its own. It’s the easiest big family gift of the season.

TCL 65” S4CF Series 4K UHD HDR Smart TV with Fire TV (2026) at Best Buy
A 2026 TCL 65-inch 4K TV with Fire TV built in, a Best Buy Doorbuster at $229.99. It’s a budget set, but it’s hard to get this much screen for less.

Shark DePuffi Instant Hot + Cold Contrast Therapy Tool at Best Buy
Shark’s hot-and-cold face tool is $149.99 at Best Buy, $50 off. It is one of the more talked-about beauty gifts this year, and Ulta has the same price.

Dyson V9 Motorbar Cordless Vacuum at Walmart
A new Dyson V9 Motorbar, sold by Dyson’s own store on Walmart, is a Black Friday Deal at $269.95. Its head is built to stop hair wrapping, which pet owners will notice.

Crock-Pot Manual 7-Quart Slow Cooker at Walmart
A plain, big Crock-Pot with three settings and room for a whole roast or a party batch of chili. Walmart has it as a Rollback at $31.98 in Mussel Grey; other colors cost more.

Amazon Kindle Paperwhite 16GB (2024) at Amazon
The current Paperwhite has a 7-inch glare-free screen, a water-resistant body and weeks of battery. It’s one of the easiest gifts for a reader, and Amazon has it in its Black Friday sale.

Target Black Friday Sale at Target
Target’s Black Friday deals are live now and run through November 29. Toys, clothing, headphones, TVs and Apple gear are all in it, with some online-only deals that change daily.

Walmart Black Friday Deals & More at Walmart
Walmart’s Black Friday Deals & More event is live online, with vacuums, kitchen gear, TVs and toys marked down. Check who the seller is, since marketplace listings sit beside Walmart’s own.
